audit.summary: The 320x480 ad unit has three critical blockers: (1) unreadable/cut-off red text in the yellow section ("Découvrez les Nouveautés LEGO" initial state shows red underline on "Nouveautés" that appears truncated or misaligned), (2) inconsistent carousel product labeling—labels appear in different positions and styles across states (white bar vs dark bar, top vs bottom alignment), (3) font and size inconsistencies in the French copy across carousel states suggest missing or broken typography application. Minor warnings include CTA button spacing at bottom edge and potential color contrast issues on yellow background.

findings.issue: Red text underline on 'Nouveautés' in initial state appears cut off or misaligned; text readability compromised in the yellow section headline.
findings.fix_hint: Verify the underline element (likely a <u> or <span> with border-bottom) has correct width and position. Check that the parent headline container does not clip or overflow. Ensure text wrapping is correct and underline spans only the intended word.

findings.issue: Carousel product category labels inconsistent across states: 'ACCESSOIRES JARDIN' (white bar, centered bottom), 'ÉLÉMENTS LIFESTYLE' (white bar, centered bottom), 'CADRE PHOTO LEGO' (dark bar, bottom-left). Label styling, position, and background color are not uniform.
findings.fix_hint: Standardize the product label style in carousel. Define a single label template with consistent background color, text color, width, and bottom positioning. Apply the same CSS class to all carousel label elements (#ad-320x480 .carousel-label { background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }). Ensure all carousel states use this rule.

findings.issue: French headline copy differs significantly across carousel states ('Découvrez les Nouveautés LEGO', 'La vie en briques', 'Construis tes souvenirs'); font weight, size, and color appear inconsistent (some red, some black on yellow). Missing or broken typography hierarchy.
findings.fix_hint: Apply consistent typography to carousel headlines. Define #ad-320x480 .carousel-headline { font-family: 'Cera Pro', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 28px; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; padding: 16px 12px; } and #ad-320x480 .carousel-headline .red-text { color: #E3000B; text-decoration: underline; } for emphasized words. Ensure all carousel frames apply this class.

findings.issue: CTA button 'EXPLORER MAINTENANT' is visually close to the bottom edge of the 320x480 frame; minimal visible padding below the button before the copyright line. Safe zone may be compromised.
findings.fix_hint: Increase bottom padding of #ad-320x480 .cta-button or its parent container to ensure at least 20px gap between button baseline and frame bottom. Adjust: #ad-320x480 { padding-bottom: 20px; } or #ad-320x480 .cta-wrapper { margin-bottom: 20px; }.

findings.issue: Carousel dot indicators (carousel pagination) are visible and styled, but their color/opacity is not clearly differentiated between active and inactive states across initial/animated/settled screenshots.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure carousel pagination dots have distinct styling. Apply #ad-320x480 .carousel-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #A5A5A5; margin: 0 4px; } and #ad-320x480 .carousel-dot.active { background: #E3000B; } to all dot elements.

findings.issue: Product images in carousel appear to have different aspect ratios or scaling across states; some crop differently (bricks pile vs lifestyle scene vs photo frame). Possible layout shift or missing image sizing rule.
findings.fix_hint: Set a fixed aspect ratio and sizing for carousel product images. Apply #ad-320x480 .carousel-image { width: 100%; max-height: 200px; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; display: block; } to ensure consistent image display regardless of source aspect ratio.

audit.regeneration_prompt:
1. Fix headline underline positioning: ensure .carousel-headline <u> or red-text span has correct width, no overflow or clipping.
2. Standardize carousel product label (white background, centered bottom, 12px font) across all carousel states.
3. Apply consistent #ad-320x480 .carousel-headline styling (Cera Pro 700, 28px, black text, red underline on emphasized words).
4. Add 20px bottom padding to #ad-320x480 or CTA wrapper to ensure safe zone gap above copyright.
5. Define distinct active/inactive states for carousel pagination dots (#E3000B active, #A5A5A5 inactive).
6. Set fixed carousel product image sizing with object-fit: cover for consistent scaling across all carousel frames.
